<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2025334_fac.FacilityVendorQualifier</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>FacilityVendorQualifier</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Returns a reference-qualifier filter for the Facility Request vendor field.
 * Usage (dictionary reference qualifier):
 *   javascript:FacilityVendorQualifier(current ? current.getValue('issue_category') : '')
 *
 * @param {string} category - the request's issue_category value (e.g. 'water_leak')
 * @returns {string} encoded query restricting Company to the vendors covering that category
 */
function FacilityVendorQualifier(category) {
    // Every returned filter keeps these two guarantees:
    //   1. the company is flagged as a vendor
    //   2. the company is active  -> retired vendors disappear from pickers automatically
    // 'sys_idIN' is completed below with the matching company ids.
    const BASE = 'vendor=true^active=true^sys_idIN';

    // No category yet (new unsaved record) -> match nothing.
    // 'sys_idIN0' is a deliberate impossible condition: sys_id '0' never exists,
    // so the picker shows an empty list instead of every company.
    if (!category) {
        return BASE + '0';
    }

    // Ask the coverage table: "who handles this kind of issue?"
    const ids = [];
    const coverage = new GlideRecord('x_2025334_fac_vendor_coverage');
    coverage.addQuery('category', category);              // rows for this request's category
    coverage.addQuery('vendor.active', true);             // dot-walk: the company must be active
    coverage.addQuery('vendor.vendor', true);             // dot-walk: and flagged as a vendor
    coverage.query();

    // Collect the company ids from the matching rows.
    // coverage.vendor is a reference field; toString() gives the sys_id it points to.
    while (coverage.next()) {
        ids.push(coverage.vendor.toString());
    }

    // Join the ids into a comma-separated list for sys_idIN.
    // Empty list -> empty string -> '||=' swaps in '0' so the filter matches nothing.
    let list = ids.join(',');
    list ||= '0';

    // e.g. vendor=true^active=true^sys_idIN6816f79cc0a8016401c5a33be04be441
    return BASE + list;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-11 11:40:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>20881985c31f4b50aaf4921ed4013139</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FacilityVendorQualifier</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Facilities Maintenance" source="x_2025334_fac">009dc1c8c39b4350aaf4921ed4013110</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Facilities Maintenance">009dc1c8c39b4350aaf4921ed4013110</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_20881985c31f4b50aaf4921ed4013139</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-11 11:55:49</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
